bundle.shortDescription: Plants of the Western Ghats: names, synonyms, distribution maps, pictures and flora records
bundle.longDescription: Version 1 (original): the 2003-04 Sasya Sahyadri database rebuilt. Search the plants of the Western Ghats by family, genus, species, common name or grid; see taxonomy, pictures, distribution, synonyms, common names and the floras that record each plant. Works offline.
